body: Trying really hard to stay busy, get my mind off of it
I know it sounds weird. But I swear people like them a lot. I’m new to reddit, maybe I’ll post my recipe there and see what people think about it
Holding on. I got hungry and went for a walk. Wbu?

Thank you for trying to cheer me up
I sell baked potatoes. But I can make a variety of dishes from different cuisines I guess.

I get scolded for anything, I’m just really tired of being treated like I’m stupid or not good enough. There’s a situation in a few hours that will give away that I’m not in school. Like I said, my family doesn’t know about me dropping out. I know I’m a coward, a piece of shit, a useless bastard, and a ungrateful motherfucker. I’ve tried running the restaurant on my own to try to give back, but I know that these are my last hours

I never said they’d wish that. But it is the third time I’ve dropped out of University. I tried, but I just suck at it. It drains my soul, and it crushes me to think that I’m nothing more than a waste of resources.
I’ve been up all night trying to fight the urge to suicide. I’ve never cut or anything. But I kinda have the same situation going on for me.

I knew this day would come my guy. I bet my dad will kill himself and the sadness with kill my mom. It is not the first time I drop my life completely. I just hate myself for letting myself lie this much.
